name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Netweb Technologies India (NTI) is one of India‘s leading high-end computing solutions (HCS) providers, with fully integrated design and manufacturing capabilities.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
Netweb is a leading provider of high-end computing solutions (HCS) in India, offering fully integrated design and manufacturing capabilities. [1] The company’s supercomputers have appeared 15 times across three entries in the global Top 500 supercomputers ranking. [2]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 96.3% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.4%
cons: Stock is trading at 32.0 times its book value
